```yaml
name: AI Docs Review Command

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        description: 'Pull Request Number'
        required: true
        type: string

jobs:
  ai-docs-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install requests pygithub

      - name: Validate PR number
        id: validate_pr_number
        run: |
          import sys
          try:
            int(${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }})
          except ValueError:
            print(f"Error: '{${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }}' is not a valid PR number.")
            sys.exit(1)

      - name: Authenticate as Octavia Bot GitHub App
        id: authenticate_bot
        run: echo "::set-env name=OCTAVIA_BOT_TOKEN::${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_TOKEN }}"

      - name: Fetch changed files
        id: fetch_changed_files
        run: |
          pr_number=${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }}
          octavia_token=${{ env.OCTAVIA_BOT_TOKEN }}
          repo_owner=airbytehq
          repo_name=airbyte
          changed_files=$(curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $octavia_token" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" https://api.github.com/repos/$repo_owner/$repo_name/pulls/$pr_number/files | jq -r '.[].filename')
          echo "Changed files: $changed_files"
          echo "::set-output name=changed_files::$changed_files"

      - name: Check for connector changes
        id: check_connector_changes
        run: |
          connector_path_pattern='^airbyte-integrations/connectors/[^/]+/'
          changed_files=${{ steps.fetch_changed_files.outputs.changed_files }}
          connector_changes=$(echo "$changed_files" | grep -E "$connector_path_pattern")
          echo "Connector changes: $connector_changes"
          echo "::set-output name=connector_changes::$connector_changes"

      - name: Post status comment
        id: post_status_comment
        run: |
          pr_number=${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }}
          connector_changes=${{ steps.check_connector_changes.outputs.connector_changes }}
          if [ -z "$connector_changes" ]; then
            comment="Skipping AI docs review as there are no connector changes."
            action="skipped"
          elif [ "$action" == "error" ]; then
            comment="AI docs review failed."
            action="failed"
          else
            comment="Starting AI docs review..."
            action="started"
          fi
          curl -X POST -H "Authorization: token ${{ github.token }}" -d "{\"body\": \"$comment\"}" https://api.github.com/repos/airbytehq/airbyte/issues/$pr_number/comments

      - name: Trigger Devin action
        if: steps.check_connector_changes.outputs.connector_changes != ''
        run: |
          pr_number=${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }}
          octavia_token=${{ env.OCTAVIA_BOT_TOKEN }}
          connector_changes=${{ steps.check_connector_changes.outputs.connector_changes }}
          curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $octavia_token" -d "{\"playbook_macro\": \"!connectordocs_pr_review\", \"issue_number\": \"$pr_number\", \"prompt_text\": \"$connector_changes\"}" https://api.devin.ai/v1/actions
```
